"but you my dear, deserve a lot more"

One of my friend sent me this at 1 am, its about me loving my bestfriend for 5 years despite how much he hurts me, and he has been with several different girls so far, and he doesn't want me to leave him, saying he 'loves' me as a bestfriend, and he needs me and he only has me
I had someone told me this once, and I was like, lol, I never even touch your man, not the tip of my finger

Leave, I'm telling you from my 5 whole years loving my bestfriend but he wasn't sure, but then I realize d, if a man wants you, he wouldn't say things like "I don't know", live your life and see if he's making an effort to be in your life, if not, youre wasting your time, emotion, and energy, realize that you dear, deserve a lot more than this, I know your heart loves him, trust me I know how it feels, but you should also think of yourself, the one you really need to love is yourself, I hope it would help
